clips.title: The story
paras: Warden Thelwater demands proof that the Stockade uprising has been crushed. The severed head of Bazil Thredd is meant to show that the rebellion's leader is dead and Defias control of Stormwind's prison has ended.

Bazil Thredd led the uprising in the Stockade beneath Stormwind City. From his cell block, he directed the riots with the help of loyal Defias inmates. Warden Thelwater distrusts outsiders and struggles to keep order. He demands Thredd's head as proof that the ringleader is dead and to test the adventurer's allegiance to Stormwind.
